then.heading: then
then.description: Pipes one expression into the next expression from left to right. The right side can read the previous successful step through system.result.
then.example: score := Load() then Normalize(input: system.result) then Rank(input: system.result)

system:result.heading: system.result
system:result.description: Read-only value for the previous successful step inside the right side of a then pipeline. It is unavailable outside that pipeline scope.

lambda.heading: lambda
lambda.description: Filters or maps an array/fact collection with a local immutable item variable.

ParseDoc.heading: ParseDoc
ParseDoc.description: Demo parser function used by method-style examples to map document text.

count.heading: count
count.description: Returns the number of items in an array or fact/type collection.

average.heading: average
average.description: Returns the average of a numeric array.

sort.heading: sort
sort.description: Sorts an array of numbers or strings.

search.heading: search
search.description: Filters strings in an array using substring matching.

contains.heading: contains
contains.description: Checks a string substring or array membership.

length.heading: length
length.description: Returns the length of a string or array.

throw.heading: throw
throw.description: Signals an exception reason. With target:, routes the message to a handler rule.
throw.example: throw(msg: "thrown from module a", target: DivideFailureHandler)

type.heading: type
type.description: Reads the concrete fact/type name from a map value that carries runtime type metadata.

instanceof.heading: instanceof
instanceof.description: Succeeds when a value is an instance of the requested fact/type, including parents declared with extend.

math:add.heading: math.add
math:add.description: Adds two numbers and unifies the result with the output argument.

math:sub.heading: math.sub
math:sub.description: Subtracts right from left and unifies the result with the output argument.

math:mul.heading: math.mul
math:mul.description: Multiplies two numbers and unifies the result with the output argument.

math:div.heading: math.div
math:div.description: Divides left by right and unifies the result with the output argument.

math:mod.heading: math.mod
math:mod.description: Computes the numeric remainder and unifies it with the output argument.

str:len.heading: str.len
str:len.description: Unifies the output argument with the length of a string.

str:contains.heading: str.contains
str:contains.description: Succeeds when the string contains the requested substring.

str:concat.heading: str.concat
str:concat.description: Concatenates two strings and unifies the result with the output argument.

str:lower.heading: str.lower
str:lower.description: Lowercases a string and unifies the result with the output argument.

str:upper.heading: str.upper
str:upper.description: Uppercases a string and unifies the result with the output argument.

str:trim.heading: str.trim
str:trim.description: Removes leading and trailing whitespace from a string.

str:split.heading: str.split
str:split.description: Splits a string by a non-empty delimiter and returns an array of strings.

str:replace.heading: str.replace
str:replace.description: Replaces all occurrences of a search string with a replacement string.

str:startsWith.heading: str.startsWith
str:startsWith.description: Returns 1.0 when a string starts with the requested prefix, otherwise 0.0.

str:endsWith.heading: str.endsWith
str:endsWith.description: Returns 1.0 when a string ends with the requested suffix, otherwise 0.0.

array:get.heading: array.get
array:get.description: Reads an array item by zero-based index and unifies it with the output argument.

array:len.heading: array.len
array:len.description: Unifies the output argument with the number of array items.

array:push.heading: array.push
array:push.description: Creates an array with one appended value and unifies it with the output argument.

fn:array.heading: fn:array
fn:array.description: Creates an immutable Felidae array value from the data argument.

fn:pair.heading: fn:pair
fn:pair.description: Creates an immutable pair value with first and last fields.

fn:tuple.heading: fn:tuple
fn:tuple.description: Creates an immutable tuple-style value from named fields.

pair:first.heading: pair:first
pair:first.description: Unifies the output argument with the first item of a pair.

pair:second.heading: pair:second
pair:second.description: Unifies the output argument with the second item of a pair.

json:parse.heading: json.parse
json:parse.description: Parses JSON text into Felidae map/array values.

json:get.heading: json.get
json:get.description: Reads a key from a JSON/map value and unifies it with the output argument.

json:has.heading: json.has
json:has.description: Returns 1.0 when a JSON/map value contains the requested key, otherwise 0.0.

json:keys.heading: json.keys
json:keys.description: Returns an array containing the keys of a JSON/map value.

json:set.heading: json.set
json:set.description: Returns a copy of a JSON/map value with one key added or replaced.

json:remove.heading: json.remove
json:remove.description: Returns a copy of a JSON/map value without the requested key.

json:toText.heading: json.toText
json:toText.description: Serializes Felidae values, arrays, maps, and fact-like rows into JSON text.

csv:parse.heading: csv.parse
csv:parse.description: Parses CSV text directly in RegisterVm and returns an array of row maps.

csv:toFacts.heading: csv.toFacts
csv:toFacts.description: Parses CSV text into retained native facts of a type declared in the loaded IR module.

csv:toText.heading: csv.toText
csv:toText.description: Writes an array of row maps back to CSV text directly in RegisterVm.

csv:toFelidaeFacts.heading: csv.toFelidaeFacts
csv:toFelidaeFacts.description: Converts row maps into Felidae fact declaration text.

console:readLine.heading: console.readLine
console:readLine.description: Reads one line from standard input using the native C++ console implementation.

console:write.heading: console.write
console:write.description: Writes a value to standard output without a trailing newline.

console:writeLine.heading: console.writeLine
console:writeLine.description: Writes a value to standard output with a trailing newline.

system:print.heading: system.print
system:print.description: Prints a value to standard output with a trailing newline. The system library is available automatically.

file:readFile.heading: file.readFile
file:readFile.description: Reads a bounded file as text directly through the RegisterVm file service.

file:readLines.heading: file.readLines
file:readLines.description: Reads a file and returns an immutable array of lines.

file:readLine.heading: file.readLine
file:readLine.description: Reads a single zero-based line from a file.

file:writeFile.heading: file.writeFile
file:writeFile.description: Writes text to a file, replacing existing content.

file:writeLines.heading: file.writeLines
file:writeLines.description: Writes an array of strings to a file, one line per item.

file:appendFile.heading: file.appendFile
file:appendFile.description: Appends text to a file through the native C++ file implementation.

file:exists.heading: file.exists
file:exists.description: Returns 1.0 when a path exists, otherwise 0.0.

file:deleteFile.heading: file.deleteFile
file:deleteFile.description: Deletes a file and returns 1.0 when a file was removed, otherwise 0.0.

http:get.heading: http.get
http:get.description: Fetches a URL through the native cpp-httplib-backed HTTP module.

http:post.heading: http.post
http:post.description: Sends a POST request through the native cpp-httplib-backed HTTP module.

http:put.heading: http.put
http:put.description: Sends a PUT request through the native cpp-httplib-backed HTTP module.

http:delete.heading: http.delete
http:delete.description: Sends a DELETE request through the native cpp-httplib-backed HTTP module.

http:serveStatic.heading: http.serveStatic
http:serveStatic.description: Starts a blocking local server whose GET, POST, PUT, and DELETE / endpoints return the provided response.

process:platform.heading: process.platform
process:platform.description: Returns the current OS platform name: windows, linux, macos, or unknown.

process:exec.heading: process.exec
process:exec.description: Runs an explicit shell command and returns captured output. Use only in trusted scripts/tests.

process:sleep.heading: process.sleep
process:sleep.description: Sleeps for the provided number of milliseconds.

math:sqrt.heading: math.sqrt
math:sqrt.description: Returns the square root of a number.

math:pow.heading: math.pow
math:pow.description: Raises a base number to an exponent.

math:sin.heading: math.sin
math:sin.description: Returns the sine of a numeric value.

math:cos.heading: math.cos
math:cos.description: Returns the cosine of a numeric value.

math:tan.heading: math.tan
math:tan.description: Returns the tangent of a numeric value.

math:asin.heading: math.asin
math:asin.description: Returns the arcsine of a numeric value.

math:acos.heading: math.acos
math:acos.description: Returns the arccosine of a numeric value.

math:atan.heading: math.atan
math:atan.description: Returns the arctangent of a numeric value.

math:atan2.heading: math.atan2
math:atan2.description: Returns the arctangent of y/x using both signs to select the quadrant.

math:log.heading: math.log
math:log.description: Returns the natural logarithm of a number.

math:log10.heading: math.log10
math:log10.description: Returns the base-10 logarithm of a number.

math:exp.heading: math.exp
math:exp.description: Returns e raised to the provided numeric value.

math:abs.heading: math.abs
math:abs.description: Returns the absolute value of a number.

math:floor.heading: math.floor
math:floor.description: Rounds a number down to the nearest integer value.

math:ceil.heading: math.ceil
math:ceil.description: Rounds a number up to the nearest integer value.

math:round.heading: math.round
math:round.description: Rounds a number to the nearest integer value.

math:random.heading: math.random
math:random.description: Returns a random floating-point number between min and max.

ml:sigmoid.heading: ml.sigmoid
ml:sigmoid.description: Applies the sigmoid activation function to one numeric value.

ml:relu.heading: ml.relu
ml:relu.description: Applies the ReLU activation function to one numeric value.

ml:dot.heading: ml.dot
ml:dot.description: Computes the dot product of two numeric arrays of equal length.

ml:meanSquaredError.heading: ml.meanSquaredError
ml:meanSquaredError.description: Computes mean squared error for two numeric arrays of equal length.

thread:createThread.heading: thread.createThread
thread:createThread.description: Creates a handle for running a method on an independent interpreter snapshot.

thread:start.heading: thread.start
thread:start.description: Starts a Felidae thread handle and returns its lifecycle status.

thread:result.heading: thread.result
thread:result.description: Waits for a Felidae thread to finish and returns the worker method result.

thread:status.heading: thread.status
thread:status.description: Reads the current status of a Felidae thread handle.
